title: DarkMusic 1.5.19 Release
changelog:
• New Lossless Server: Fully migrated to high-speed reactivated Oracle server (130.210.50.47).
• True 24-Bit Hi-Res Audio: Sample-format detection fix for pure 24-bit studio playback.
• Cover Artwork: Full high-resolution cover artwork restored for all tracks.
• Offline Mode Toggle: Dedicated Go Offline / Go Online switch added in header menu.
• UI Refinements: Snug header settings gear layout.
releaseNotes: v1.5.19: Reactivated cloud server migration (130.210.50.47), true 24-bit hi-res audio & cover artwork fixes, offline toggle, and snug header layout.
